feedback.issue: The report states 'The final console/comms/no-twitch regressions are being run… Their final results belong below; no pass is claimed yet.' But those tests did complete and pass: ship-console-test 136/0, comms-station 42/0, comms-history 37/0 (regressions2.log), no-twitch 41/0 (.godot/tmp/no-twitch.log). The report was written mid-run and not updated with its own promised results.
feedback.suggestion: Append the actual test results to the evidence table in the report before landing.

feedback.issue: restore() returns early without calling scroll.queue_free() when original is not is_instance_valid(). The ScrollContainer wrapper is then leaked. Unlikely in practice (original is always a persistent panel), but it is an unconditional resource leak on an unexpected path.
feedback.suggestion: Cache scroll before the guard and call scroll.queue_free() in both branches, or reassign WRAPPER meta to null/remove it and free unconditionally after the early return.

feedback.issue: authorized() uses avatar_pos.distance_to(chair_seat()) < 0.05 (5 cm). If the physics step or a walk-advance puts the avatar 50 mm off the contact point, authority is immediately revoked. The parity test held 1,202 ticks without a drop, so this is not an observed failure, but the tolerance is tight enough that a future pose change could break it silently.
feedback.suggestion: Consider widening to 0.08–0.10 m, matching the measurement tolerance documented in CaptainChairContact (TOLERANCE_M = 0.01 for the contact match itself, but that is a different quantity). At minimum, add a comment explaining why 0.05 is correct here.

feedback.issue: Design doc requires a companion design-repo clarification (amending D-56, recording D-149 in bridge/ship UI design). Sprint plan section C3 notes this as a deliverable. It has not been filed.
feedback.suggestion: File the design-repo companion PR (sunholo-data/stapledons-design) recording D-149 before landing. It can be a one-paragraph addition to the bridge-interior feature doc.

feedback.issue: make captain-command-capture and captain-chair-contact-capture have not been run. These are required by AC7 and are the only visual evidence for contact and layout. No clipping verdict can be issued from code alone.
feedback.suggestion: Run both capture targets when the GPU is free; inspect every rendered frame before filing for Mark's review.
